response_property_constraints.description: The Response field must be one of the enumerated string values 'True' or 'False'.
The Poster field, when not 'N/A', must be a valid URI string.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'type' is provided, every item in the Search array must have a Type equal to that value.
When the request parameter 'y' is provided, every item in the Search array should have a Year matching that release year.
